adrs.title: Hydration — Inline Payload + One Client Bundle
adrs.statusDetail: Public summary (the full decision record lives in the internal log)
adrs.decision: Embed a JSON hydration payload in the document and hydrate from one hashed client bundle; error pages are server-only.

adrs.title: SSR Streaming — Opt-in, Edge Renderer
adrs.statusDetail: Public summary (the full decision record lives in the internal log)
adrs.decision: Streaming is opt-in via app.streaming/createPageRoutes; react-dom/server.edge renderers; error pages stay synchronous and errors after the first byte close the stream.

adrs.title: Server Actions — Form Mutations First-Class
adrs.statusDetail: Public summary (the full decision record lives in the internal log)
adrs.decision: Pages may export action + actionSchema (POST to the same path); 303 PRG redirects; forms work without JavaScript; action result re-renders the page.

adrs.title: Target Edge/Serverless
adrs.statusDetail: Public summary (the full decision record lives in the internal log)
adrs.decision: ramonyx build --target edge emits a single { fetch } artifact with statically imported pages/API/middleware, inlined asset map, and a build guard against node:*; workerd smoke test in CI.

adrs.title: Revalidation (ISR-lite) — Loader Data, Not HTML
adrs.statusDetail: Public summary (the full decision record lives in the internal log)
adrs.decision: revalidate caches loader data with stale-while-revalidate; cookies/query bypass the cache; cacheTags + revalidate() invalidate on demand; store is pluggable.

adrs.title: Asset Pipeline — Manifest + Resolver
adrs.statusDetail: Public summary (the full decision record lives in the internal log)
adrs.decision: src/assets is hashed into a manifest; assets.url()/assets.image() feed loaders and Image; edge inlines the map; URLs map 1:1 to the client output root.

adrs.title: MCP Docs Server — stdio, No Hosting
adrs.statusDetail: Public summary (the full decision record lives in the internal log)
adrs.decision: Package @ramonyx/mcp-docs-server runs MCP over stdio with no external dependencies and five tools; the npm package bundles a public docs snapshot and is verified in the release pipeline.

adrs.title: i18n — Primitives + Locale Routing
adrs.statusDetail: Public summary (the full decision record lives in the internal log)
adrs.decision: Edge-safe primitives (negotiation, localePath, createTranslator); per-locale literal routes; default locale unprefixed with 308 normalization; lang/dir + hreflang; locale-aware cache keys; no automatic redirects.
